description: A RANKED LIST OF CRYPTOS, sized by you: choose how many (1-20) and an optional minimum Startingale. Use this when those two are the ONLY conditions; anything else (a venue, a round count, a minimum Martingale Score) needs search_instruments. For a fixed top 5 with no arguments, use crypto_overview. Answers in formatted text. Costs 3 units of the monthly quota.

limit.description: How many to return, highest Martingale Score first. 1-20, default 10.

min_startingale.description: Keep only entries at or above this Startingale reading: how well the CURRENT price sits versus the structure, unlike the Martingale Score which ranks them. Scale 0-5: 4.3 and above reads Strong, 3.7 and above Favorable, 3 and above Moderate, below that Misaligned. Default: 0 (no filter).

name: list_top_crypto
